name: Yeekit: Stars Rating Field for Elementor Forms
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
Stars Rating Field for Elementor Forms extends Elementor Pro Forms by adding new rating-style fields such as Stars and Like/Dislike. Perfect for collecting user feedback, reviews, satisfaction surveys, or voting directly inside your Elementor Forms.

Demo: https://demo.add-ons.org/demo-stars-rating-field-for-elementor-forms/
Documentation: https://add-ons.org/document-stars-rating-field-for-elementor-forms/

Perfect for

  • Product or service reviews.
  • Customer satisfaction ratings.
  • Quick feedback forms.
  • Like / Dislike voting.
  • Polls and surveys.

Features

  • Add Stars Rating and Like/Dislike fields into Elementor Forms.
  • Customizable max stars, half-stars, icons, and colors.
  • Adjustable size and spacing.
  • Supports validation (required rating before submission).
  • Smooth hover and click animations.
  • Works perfectly inside Elementor popups or AJAX-loaded forms.
  • Lazy-loads JS/CSS only when the rating field is detected — optimized for performance.

Usage

  1. Edit your form with Elementor Pro.
  2. Add a new field and choose Stars Rating or Like/Dislike type.
  3. Configure star count, colors, and icons in field settings.
  4. Save the form and preview — your visitors can now rate directly!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stars-rating-field-for-elementor-forms directory, or install it directly from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit an Elementor form and add a new Stars Rating or Like/Dislike field.
  4. Customize its appearance and behavior in the field settings.
  5. Save your form and start collecting feedback instantly.

  • Initial release — add Stars Rating and Like/Dislike fields for Elementor Forms.
